column2: 1. A person shall be disqualified from being appointed or continuing

column1: as  a  member  of  the  Board,  if  he—

column2: is or becomes a Member of Parliament, any Provincial Council
directly  or  indirectly  holds  or  enjoys  any  right  or  benefit
under  any  contract  made  by  or  on  behalf  of  the  Institute  ;
is under any law in force in Sri Lanka or in any other country,
found  or  declared  to  be  of  unsound  mind  ;
is  a  person  who  having  been  declared  an  insolvent  or  a
bankrupt  under  any  law  in  force  in  Sri  Lanka  or  in  any  other
county,  is  an  undischarged  insolvent  or  bankrupt  ;  or
is  a  person  who  has  been  convicted  of  any  offence  by  any
court  in  Sri  Lanka  or  any  other  country.
